author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
Gardening and AI coding are good compliment tasks. 

You let AI runs for hour an hour writing code while you are taking care of your veggie garden.  When you are tried from yard work and need to take a break, you can chat with your AI a little bit before going back outside. 

You can still think about the coding program while your hands are busy digging
